headline: Customers Struggle to Pay Installments, Bad Loans at 5 Leasing Companies Swell
summary: Indonesia's financial regulator OJK identified five multifinance companies with non-performing financing ratios above 5% as customers struggle with installment payments.
why: Multifinance companies provide vehicle and consumer financing in Indonesia, and rising non-performing financing (NPF) signals stress in their loan books.
original_headline: Nasabah Mulai Sulit Bayar Cicilan, Kredit Macet 5 Leasing Bengkak
